Net income is attributable to owners. Parent-attributable equity and diluted EPS use the2025 audited statements for2024–2025; the historical summary total equity includes minorities and its EPS is basic, so those are not substituted.
totalDebt is the published interest-bearing debt in the summary; lease liabilities are not added.

Dividends2016–2022 are the split-adjusted amounts published in2025 (three-for-one split1March2023);2007–2015 retain the per-share basis published in2015. Do not compare these without the stated basis change.

The summary labels share count as issued shares including treasury stock (2025 report); no subtraction/derived outstanding count made. Capital expenditure summary does not establish the required cash purchases basis; capex is left null. Employees are the full-time / total employees defined in the summary, excluding part-time workers.
